pipeline.title: Boehringer, Microsoft team up to explore digital patient twins for clinical trials
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and Microsoft have launched a collaboration to explore the use of AI-powered digital patient twins to improve clinical trial design.

pipeline.title: Novartis' Rhapsido touts solid efficacy with industry-best safety data in RMS phase 3 reveal
pipeline.summary: In new data from Novartis' Remodel-1 and Remodel-2, Rhapsido's safety profile helped compensate for its solid but lower-than-expected efficacy data in RMS.

pipeline.title: BioNTech sees ‘limited’ benefit to ADC after phase 3 reveals modest efficacy, ILD cases
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has reported modest efficacy and unexpected safety findings in a phase 3 breast cancer trial, leading the company to conclude its HER2-directed candidate may offer limited benefits in the current treatment landscape.

pipeline.title: ESMO: BMS’ Massacesi hails ‘very promising’ data for BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi, M.D., has told Fierce that the latest data for its BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug are “very promising,” as phase 3 ambitions ramp up.v

pipeline.title: ESMO: In sac-TMT’s first global phase 3 win, Merck sees ‘pretty consistent’ data with China
pipeline.summary: As a cornerstone of Merck’s post-Keytruda oncology strategy, sac-TMT has cleared a clinical milestone. In its first global phase 3 win, the TROP2 ADC delivered results that are “pretty consistent” with earlier China data, according to Merck’s head of oncology clinical development

pipeline.title: ESMO: Why Incyte sees itself ‘neck and neck’ with RevMed in KRAS G12D pancreatic cancer race
pipeline.summary: Incyte has pointed to a spread of phase 1 data for its KRAS G12D inhibitor as evidence that the company has a worthy rival to Revolution Medicines in this increasingly competitive cancer space.

pipeline.title: ‘Infinite potential’: Akeso CEO looks for more ivonescimab combos amid AstraZeneca investment, new phase 3 win
pipeline.summary: With ivonescimab’s first phase 3 win outside lung cancer and a $2 billion investment from AstraZeneca in its U.S. partner Summit Therapeutics, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is expecting more combination opportunities for its star PD-1xVEGF bispecific.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Bristol Myers CMO touts ‘5 out of 5’ positive phase 3 trials for bispecific ADC iza-bren
pipeline.summary: Buoyed by a clean sweep of five positive phase 3 readouts in China, Bristol Myers’ Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi, M.D., is voicing growing confidence in the company's first-in-class bispecific ADC iza-bren, even as the New Jersey pharma has yet to match one China study

pipeline.title: ESMO: Roche touts ‘convincing’ phase 3 KRAS data after win over rivals
pipeline.summary: Roche has shed more light on its investigational KRAS G12C inhibitor’s phase 3 victory over Amgen’s Lumakras and Bristol Myers Squibb’s Krazati.

pipeline.title: ESMO: AstraZeneca exec insists phase 3 ADC data ‘robust’ enough for regulators despite PFS miss
pipeline.summary: An AstraZeneca executive was adamant that detailed data from a phase 3 study of the pharma’s next-generation antibody-drug conjugate are “robust” enough to take to regulators, despite the trial failing to meet a key endpoint.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Genmab posts phase 3 win for Elahere rival, ahead of ‘very interesting’ data from Merus buyout
pipeline.summary: Genmab may have arrived in Spain with updated data from a pair of phase 2 studies from the main prize of its Merus buyout, but the company had bigger news to share.

pipeline.title: ESMO: AZ, Hutchmed’s Orpathys combo shows post-Tagrisso power in MET-driven lung cancer
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has offered a detailed look at the phase 3 non-small cell lung cancer data that finally position its Hutchmed-partnered Orpathys for an FDA approval more than five years after the MET inhibitor’s initial go-ahead in China.

pipeline.title: Bayer's Nubeqa scores phase 3 win in high-risk prostate cancer
pipeline.summary: Nubeqa, when added to standard-of-care treatment, significantly improved metastasis-free survival in patients with very high-risk localized prostate cancer.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Merck, Kelun’s ‘workhorse’ ADC posts major tumor progression benefit in PD-L1-negative NSCLC
pipeline.summary: Sac-TMT showed a strong tumor progression benefit in first-line, PD-L1-negative non-small cell lung cancer in a China phase 3 trial that could help Merck close a high-stakes gap in its expansive global development program for the Kelun-Biotech-partnered ADC.

pipeline.title: Argenx confirmatory trial update for Vyvgart puts small dent in strong Q3
pipeline.summary: Argenx's third quarter report reflected strong sales and pipeline plans, but investors took issue with high operating expenses and a new phase 3 requirement.

pipeline.title: Bolt makes inflammation play with Prana reverse merger, $120M financing
pipeline.summary: Bolt Biotherapeutics is acquiring Prana Therapies in a stock-for-stock reverse merger backed by a $120 million financing to advance Prana’s lead antibody through multiple phase 2 trials in inflammatory diseases.

pipeline.title: Roche puts numbers behind phase 3 kidney disease win amid blockbuster ambitions
pipeline.summary: Roche's Genentech has put numbers behind its phase 3 success in IgA nephropathy (IgAN), reporting that antisense oligonucleotide sefaxersen reduced a key marker of kidney damage by 43.1% compared with placebo.

pipeline.title: GSK's double FDA win, Roche's $15B deal and the rise of point-of-care marketing
pipeline.summary: This week on "The Top Line," we cover GSK's pair of FDA approvals, Roche's $15 billion ADC deal and the rise of point-of-care pharma marketing.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Takeda’s $1.2B bet on Innovent ‘absolutely’ pays off with details of ADC’s phase 3 win
pipeline.summary: Takeda has lifted the lid on the phase 3 win for its next-generation claudin18.2 drug, with the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) demonstrating overall survival of 10.2 months.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Boehringer builds case for late-phase rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has shared data on its DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager, providing pointers to the prospects of a would-be rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra that entered phase 3 this year.

pipeline.title: Roivant comes for Humira as Lisraya checks boxes in inflammatory eye disease phase 3s
pipeline.summary: With the ink barely dry on Lisraya’s first approval, Roivant and its spinout Priovant are wasting little time in making the case for the dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor to claim a larger immune-mediated kingdom.

pipeline.title: ESMO: GSK cancer R&D chief says mo-rez data ‘reinforces our belief’ in ADC as phase 3 push ramps up
pipeline.summary: GSK’s cancer R&D chief has suggested the latest slice of early-stage data on its B7-H4-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) has “reinforce[d] our belief in the asset,” as the therapy races through a clutch of phase 3 studies.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Lilly touts 79% ADC response rate in competitive ovarian cancer space
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has shared phase 1 data on an antibody-drug conjugate in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer, shedding light on the company’s chances of competing for a market targeted by rivals including AbbVie and Genmab.

pipeline.title: Pfizer’s Talzenna combo moves up treatment line with new FDA nod in prostate cancer
pipeline.summary: Pfizer’s Talzenna is now the first PARP inhibitor approved by the FDA to treat men with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

pipeline.title: Corxel, an obesity drugmaker, to go public via SPAC deal
pipeline.summary: Armed with a $300 million financing and two GLP-1 and amylin-targeting medicines, Corxel is set to become the latest weight loss-focused company to join the public markets.

pipeline.title: BioNTech, DualityBio say ADC had ‘modest’ benefit in breast cancer study
pipeline.summary: The companies said the findings suggest the treatment has a “limited” impact in HER2-low breast cancer, an area where AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo’s Enhertu has already set a high bar.

pipeline.title: ESMO ‘26: A cancer vaccine debate, Roche’s KRAS progress and Amgen’s ‘unprecedented’ data
pipeline.summary: At one of the year’s premiere meetings for cancer research, melanoma vaccine data hailed by scientists sparked a share sell-off on Wall Street, while a lung drug received a standing ovation.

pipeline.title: Anthropic lays out drug R&D ambitions, risks in mammoth IPO filing
pipeline.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic is pushing deeper into drug discovery, building its own molecular biology lab and investing in research that could eventually produce drug candidates, according to the company's blockbuster IPO filing.

pipeline.title: Another autoimmune CAR-T death; Treasury zeroes in on China deals
pipeline.summary: A patient who received Bristol Myers’ zola-cel died 44 days later. Elsewhere, Gilead paid nearly $1.3 billion for a potential threat to J&J’s newly approved psoriasis pill.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Tango trims headcount after impressing analysts with ‘highly synergistic’ RevMed combo
pipeline.summary: Tango disclosed a 14% reduction in headcount even as the company shared more evidence that its PRMT5 inhibitor enhances Revolution Medicines’ Rasonque.

pipeline.title: Lycia leaps onto Nasdaq with upsized $318M IPO as Windward breezes toward listing
pipeline.summary: Lycia Therapeutics went public with an upsized $317.5 million IPO on Friday, while immunology-focused Windward Bio is hoping to catch the same tailwinds.

pipeline.title: The molecule was fine. The moment wasn’t.
pipeline.summary: Some overlooked medicines aren’t failures. They just arrived before the market was ready.

pipeline.title: Novel protein and peptide therapeutics
pipeline.summary: Explore manufacturing challenges and solutions for ADCs, bispecifics, peptides and more.

pipeline.title: ESMO: J&J exec says RIPTAC readout is ‘best data we’ve ever seen’ for a prostate cancer drug
pipeline.summary: A year after paying over $3 billion for Halda Therapeutics, Johnson & Johnson has unveiled the first data from its shiny new RIPTAC pipeline it believes could sustain its leading role in prostate cancer.

pipeline.title: ‘It is what it is’: Merck exec unruffled by ‘unfortunate’ leak of ESMO cancer vaccine data
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna always knew they would make headlines in Madrid this week—just not in the way it happened.

pipeline.title: BMS sheds light on patient death in CAR-T trial, wants to get program back on track
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has shared more details with Fierce about the death of a patient who received the pharma's investigational CAR-T in a multiple sclerosis trial.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: a big year for RNAi developers
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s data visualization series features a look at the emerging popularity of RNAi developers, and the funding that came with it.

pipeline.title: Gilead to pay $1.3B upfront for PepStar’s oral IL-23 challenger to J&J’s Icotyde
pipeline.summary: Gilead has struck a deal to acquire PepStar Therapeutics’ oral IL-23 receptor inhibitor program for $1.275 billion, positioning itself as a would-be challenger to Johnson & Johnson’s Icotyde across a range of inflammatory diseases.

pipeline.title: Gilead to pay $45M as it settles Medicaid kickback allegations from Texas AG Paxton
pipeline.summary: As a snarl of pharma-focused lawsuits from Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton plays out, Gilead Sciences has worked out a deal to put its own litigation to bed.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—US Treasury homes in on China deals; Hengrui's secret sauce; Samsung Bio's strike developments
pipeline.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department is closing in on American investments in China's life sciences industry as it issued draft rules adding biotechnology to the COINS Act. Hengrui leadership sat down with Fierce to discuss the secret sauce behind the Chinese drugmaker's massive licensin

pipeline.title: Star adds $200M after spinout successes
pipeline.summary: Following exits for its subsidiaries Electra Therapeutics and Vega Therapeutics, Star is now mining for a new drug prospect.

pipeline.title: EQT buys molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen in a €10.8B deal
pipeline.summary: EQT is buying up Netherlands-based Qiagen in a deal worth €10.8 billion ($12.1 billion) in enterprise value that includes $1.1 billion in net debt.

pipeline.title: Roche pays Zymeworks $55M for trispecific challenger to Amgen’s Imdelltra
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying Zymeworks $55 million upfront for ZW209, bagging global rights to a trispecific designed to improve on the rate and depth of responses achieved by Amgen’s Imdelltra.

pipeline.title: Treasury sweeps biotech into proposed COINS Act restrictions, but spares Big Pharma’s China licensing deals
pipeline.summary: Despite the sweeping scope of the ban covering various types of drug molecules, biopharma business development teams can breathe a measured sigh of relief.

pipeline.title: Protein degrader specialist Lycia prices $318M IPO
pipeline.summary: Funds from the upsized offering will support a trio of protein-degrading medicines in development for allergic conditions as well as the autoimmune disorder Graves’ disease.

pipeline.title: Real Chemistry spotlights health dignity as key trust, engagement indicator in new research initiative
pipeline.summary: With its health dignity initiative, Real Chemistry is tapping into human experiences during healthcare interactions to gauge communication signals that could mark important engagement indicators.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Troubled CSL enlists GSK vet Deborah Waterhouse to lead
pipeline.summary: CSL has tapped a new leader to steer it through a make-or-break period. Ironwood's CEO since 2021 is hanging up his hat. CytoDyn's new helmsman is highlighting the company's "transformational period." And more.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Chasing Keytruda, AstraZeneca’s Imfinzi pitches its own Padcev combos in bladder cancer
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca is rolling out its own Imfinzi-Padcev combination pitch in cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer, hoping to differentiate from Keytruda-Padcev with a tweaked dosing regimen, while its effort to add a CTLA-4 component appears to have backfired.

pipeline.title: Moderna, Merck shares fall on eagerly anticipated cancer vaccine results
pipeline.summary: A combination of the shot and the immunotherapy Keytruda cut the risk of relapse or death by 42% in a landmark melanoma study that met Wall Street expectations but triggered a “sell-the-news reaction,” one analyst wrote.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Zentalis already dreaming of launch for WEE1 inhibitor after ‘great result’ in early-stage test
pipeline.summary: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals has pointed to the first overall survival (OS) analysis for azenosertib as proof that the oral WEE1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor can offer a convenient oral treatment for a tricky cancer.

pipeline.title: AZ's Ultomiris adds 5th rare disease feather to cap with FDA IgAN nod
pipeline.summary: With a late Thursday nod from the FDA to reduce protein levels in the urine of patients with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), AstraZeneca’s Alexion-born Ultomiris has racked up its fifth rare disease indication in the United States.

pipeline.title: Esteve earmarks $80M to revamp CDMO operations in China
pipeline.summary: In the next phase of its global expansion, Esteve is set to invest $80 million in an upgrade and relocation of its CDMO business in China.

pipeline.title: Vabysmo shows signs of reacceleration as Roche gears up for busy 2027
pipeline.summary: After disappointing Wall Street for most of 2026, Roche’s eye disease drug Vabysmo met analysts’ expectations for the first time this year. But the company may have bigger fish to fry heading into 2027.

pipeline.title: Pfizer's latest cost-savings plan looks to get early start as layoff reports surface around Europe, US plants
pipeline.summary: Local news reported Pfizer layoffs in Michigan and North Carolina as the drugmaker kicks off $2.5 billion in planned cost cuts. Pfizer declined to comment on the total number of jobs affected or when the layoffs would go into effect.

pipeline.title: FDA rebukes Baxter over 'repeated' production stumbles in new warning letter
pipeline.summary: The FDA rebuked Baxter in a lengthy warning letter that outlined a series of production violations that led to a trio of recalls earlier this year.

pipeline.title: AbbVie pumps up the economic case for early subcutaneous Parkinson’s treatment
pipeline.summary: Delaying the use of subcutaneous Parkinson’s disease treatments by one year increases annual medical costs by 59.1%, AbbVie-sponsored research found.

pipeline.title: ESMO: Amgen’s Imdelltra drives massive survival benefit in ‘watershed moment’ for small cell lung cancer
pipeline.summary: Amgen’s T-cell engager Imdelltra has posted a massive survival benefit in small cell lung cancer, delivering what Chief Medical Officer Paul Burton called a “watershed moment” for the field while drawing comparison to Rasonque in pancreatic cancer.

pipeline.title: Biopharma Companies Must Break the DMTA Linearity
pipeline.summary: Reimagining DMTA as a connected network gives scientists the flexibility to act when needed, with context retained across every decision

pipeline.title: BMS leads Pathos AI's $237M series E alongside Alzheimer's link-up
pipeline.summary: Pathos AI has closed a $237 million series E round led by pharma giant Bristol Myers Squibb on the same day that the two companies signed a cutting-edge Alzheimer's disease-focused collaboration.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill take slight dip amid holiday week
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
